issues.observed: No action is declared for the exact closed TargetSearchingState carrier; the action inventory is empty.
issues.reason: The closed model has an exact reachable TargetSearchingState carrier, but the supplied action obligation does not provide the exact lifecycle phase required to route it to S4. The deterministic action inventory is empty, so the required target-search behavior is not represented by an exact action value.
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The prose may describe an informal operational interpretation rather than a required lifecycle action, and the contract supplies no exact entry, do, or exit phase.
issues.title: Target search behavior lacks an exact lifecycle action

issues.basis: NL4 endpoint contract; source transition tr_0004; closed transition line 13 with source state:TargetSearchingState:line:7, target state:AttackState:line:9, and trigger Task_Assignment_Received.
issues.expected: TargetSearchingState -> AttackState on Task Assignment Received during flight.
issues.observed: The closed model contains transition:line:13 from TargetSearchingState to AttackState with trigger Task_Assignment_Received.
issues.reason: No issue is emitted because the exact source and target are resolved and the closed transition with the required Task Assignment Received trigger reaches AttackState.
issues.requirement_quote: During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: None identified from the supplied exact transition inventory.
issues.title: Task-assignment endpoint is present

issues.basis: NL4 effect contract; exact_source_inventory transition tr_0005; closed transition transition:line:14 has effects=[]; reference inspection reports zero variables and zero variable dataflow entries; SMT formulas are empty.
issues.expected: After Attack_Completed, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases.
locus_names: number of UAVs in the swarm
issues.observed: The closed model has no declared UAV-count variable, no variable dataflow, and no effect on transition:line:14.
issues.reason: The exact source obligation requires a variable delta after attack completion, but the closed model contains no variable inventory and the Attack_Completed transition has no effect. This is a semantic variable-delta gap, not merely a missing transition endpoint.
issues.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The supplied closed-model closure contains no alternative variable or effect representation that could encode the required decrease.
issues.title: Missing Post-Attack UAV-Count Decrease
